title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP tasks can ask for missing information or authorisation
notes: claim 80: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: Hold: the risk rationale treats the policy documentation's focus on MCP as proof that the policy covers nothing else. Microsoft says the policy layer can apply across Work IQ experiences, so its undocumented reach must remain an open question. The roadmap details, listed admin paths and Graph operations are supported.
